therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: rapid sedation and antipsychotic effect via dopaminergic and serotonergic modulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with schizophrenia experiencing acute agitation
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in BPRS total scores at 72 hours

results.effect_size: Ziprasidone: -17.32 vs Haloperidol: -18.44 (LS mean change in BPRS total score at 72 hours)
subgroup_findings: BPRS agitation subscale response (>30% reduction): Ziprasidone 149 responders vs Haloperidol 155 responders; Ziprasidone 39 non-responders vs Haloperidol 29 non-responders

dose_info.schedule: Ziprasidone: 10 mg q2h or 20 mg q4h, max 40 mg/day for 3 days; Haloperidol: 5 mg q4-8h, max 20 mg/day for 3 days
